configuration.cdpHost.markdownDescriptio: Host for the Browser CDP endpoint. Used as a fallback default for debug launch configurations that omit the `host` attribute. Use a resolvable hostname or IP address, for example `localhost` or `127.0.0.1`.
configuration.cdpPort.markdownDescriptio: TCP port for the Browser CDP endpoint. Used as a fallback default for debug launch configurations that omit the `port` attribute. Set a whole number from `1` to `65535`.
configuration.watchAutoRefreshInterval.d: Auto-refresh interval in ms for the variable watcher. 0 = disabled.
configuration.defaultCellIsolation.descr: Default execution mode for JavaScript cells that do not explicitly set jupyterBrowserKernel.isolated metadata.
configuration.defaultCellIsolation.markd: Default execution mode for JavaScript cells that do not explicitly set `jupyterBrowserKernel.isolated` metadata. When `true`, cells run isolated by default. When `false` (the default), cells share a persistent scope. Per-cell metadata always overrides this setting.
